name: 什刹海
experience_value: Acts as a mood bridge from monument-heavy Beijing into a more intimate waterside and hutong rhythm.
Strong for dusk sequencing because the waterfront, bridges, and alleys support emotional closure rather than checklist coverage.
Lets solo routes observe city tempo without forcing a hard sightseeing agenda.
avoid_when: the route needs a tightly compressed first-visit schedule with no lingering segment
winter daytime conditions weaken the waterfront payoff and make another anchor more efficient
the day already closes with a stronger evening asset and does not need a second atmospheric ending
